business_summary: Vishwaraj Sugar Industries Limited manufactures and sells sugar from sugarcane in India. It operates in five segments: Sugar, Co-Generation, Distillery, IML, and Vinegar Unit. The company also produces distillery products, including ethanol, and rectified and extra-neutral spirits; natural alcohol vinegar for industrial, further processing to convert into a preservative, and domestic consumption purposes; and bagasse, molasses/sugarcane syrups, press-mud, compost, and carbon dioxide. In addition, the company is involved in the blending and bottling of Indian-made foreign liquor (IMFL); and co-generation of electricity and steam from bagasse. The company was formerly known as Vishwanath Sugar and Steel Industries Limited and changed its name to Vishwaraj Sugar Industries Limited in November 2012. Vishwaraj Sugar Industries Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Belgaum, India.
